name: Amol Kapoor
bio: Amol Kapoor is the CEO of Nori Agentic, the company behind Nori, cloud infrastructure for running AI agents in isolated cloud environments with access to a team's code, documents, and operational knowledge. He has worked in AI and machine learning for about 12 years, including as a researcher at Google Research on graph neural networks, computer vision, 3D reconstruction, and robotics. He studied at Columbia University, co-founded the visual-filesystem company SOOT (serving as its CTO), and organizes Agentics, a New York AI community event series. At AI Engineer NYC 2026 he presented the online-track talk "Agentifying a SEC Master" with Nori Agentic CTO Clifford Ressel and their on-screen agent Jiro.
